**Date:** 19/12/2026

## Agenda

- 19:30  Recap: Session 7
- 19:35  8.1  Writing the paper (II): the optional parts and the title
- 20:00  Manuscript workshop 2: improve your Results section
- 20:30  8.2  Getting published: from checklist to reviewers
- 21:05  8.3  Be the reviewer: Papers 1 and 2, as a whole class
- 21:30  Proposal presentations (about 5 volunteers), 22:15 closing

## Timetable

| Start | Clock* | Min | Segment |
|:----|:----|---:|:------------------------------------------------------------|
| 0:00 | 19:30 | 5 | Recap |
| 0:05 | 19:35 | 25 | **8.1 Writing the paper (II): the optional parts and the title.** Introduction funnel, Discussion six moves, calibrated language, abstract, title and keywords, before you submit |
| 0:30 | 20:00 | 30 | **[DS] Manuscript workshop 2:** the class improves the Q1 Results together (numbers, tables, words, title, the optional parts: 22 min). Each participant checks their own Results draft and writes the working title (8 min), then emails the Results section by 23:59 tonight |
| 1:00 | 20:30 | 20 | **8.2 Getting published:** reporting guidelines (**EQUATOR demo**), choosing a journal, predatory journals, submission package, peer review, responding to reviewers (preprints, rejection, proofs and conference abstracts in the extra slides) |
| 1:20 | 20:50 | 15 | BREAK |
| 1:35 | 21:05 | 25 | **8.3 Be the reviewer:** simplified appraisal of Papers 1 and 2 (Boulet 2024 RCT and Hyun 2023 cohort) with the whole class, using the 10-question checklist, as reviewing practice |
| 2:00 | 21:30 | 45 | **Volunteer presentations:** about 5 volunteers present their own research proposal + publication plan (6 min + 2 min feedback each), then a 5-minute closing round, everyone submits slides and the written proposal |
| 2:45 | 22:15 | 15 | Post-course quiz, evaluation, next steps (peer review of one classmate's Results section, due 2 January 2027) |

\*Times are relative to the start of the session; the clock column shows Vietnam time for the online 19:30–22:30 session. All exercises are done by the whole class together (no groups). **[DS]** = course-dataset content (FLUID-ICU analysis and manuscript writing).

## Before this session

- Your written proposal and 6 slides, emailed to the course lead before 19:30 today (volunteers: presentation rehearsed, 6 minutes).
- Your Results draft, your results pack and the class Q1 Results from Session 7 (PDF).
- Papers 1 and 2 (the PDFs sent before Session 1) open for *Be the reviewer*.

## After this session (homework)

- **By 23:59 tonight (19 December 2026):** email your Results section (`Surname_Firstname_Results_QN.docx`) to your reviewer and the course lead ([myluong1710@gmail.com](mailto:myluong1710@gmail.com)). Optional parts go in the same file ([manuscript brief](manuscript-brief.qmd)).
- **By 2 January 2027:** review your classmate's Results section and email the review to the author and the course lead ([peer-review instructions](peer-review.qmd)).
- **By 30 January 2027:** email your revised Results section (tracked changes) and your response to the reviewer to the course lead.
- **Optional:** Parts A and C of the Session 8 sheet, and the rest of the Part D answer grid, for practice.
